title: Karti hai bayan
body:
karti hai bayaan umme laila
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
sadme se jigar phat'ta hai mera
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
wo zakhm laga tujhko dilbar
seene se nazar aata hai jigar
chalta hai mere dil par bhaala
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
armaano ki basti khaak hui
tasveer e tamanna chaak hui
khwabon ka tasalsul toot gaya
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamraah nahi koi is dam
behaal hai gham se shaahe umam
aankhon mein andhera hai chaaya
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho to qayamat ka manzar
hai sheh ka gala zere khanjar
hai shimr e layeen seene pe chada
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kurta bhi hai saara khoon mein tar
aur cheene gaye kano se gohar
dekho to behan ka haal zara
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
asbaab bhi saare lut'te hai
qaime bhi hamare jalte hai
chinti hai hamare sar se rida
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kin aankhon se dekhun ye manzar
hai noke sina par tera sar
be gor o kafan laasha hai pada
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
har lamha hai aazaron mein
hai ahle haram bazaron mein
hamdard koi baakhi na raha
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil se na gaya akbar ka khayaal
aur maa ka tha aalam ye hilal
ta umr ye lab par tha noha
ay laal ali akbar ho kahan
karti hai bayan...
author: Hilal Mirza
